description: Exact batch definitions for metadata-only CognitiveLevel and DifficultyScore correction. All changes are metadata-label adjustments — zero content, stem, choice, explanation, distractor, or answer-key modifications.

global_constraints.backup_protocol: Mandatory per BACKUP_PROTOCOL.md — timestamped .bak before every batch write
global_constraints.revision_history: Recommended per AGENTS.md §12.2 — not required (Light Lane, no content-level defect) but best practice
global_constraints.certification_impact: NONE — CognitiveLevel and DifficultyScore are metadata fields. Do not trigger CAQS §9.2 re-certification.

AF-E3.pattern: Deterministic Rule (single ASC/COSO/IMA standard determines answer)

AF-E4.pattern: Taxonomy Classification ("What type of X is described?")

AF-E6.pattern: Single Correct Option (only one defensible choice)

phases.description: Fix or archive 3 items with structural defects that block accurate reclassification reporting. These items carry HO labels but are structurally unrenderable. Must be resolved before Phase 1.

batches.description: Structural defect items: P1-FD-046 (all fields empty, Certified) + 2 additional defective items identified in S93P scan.
actions: Fix renderable items (restore stem, choices, correct answer from backup if available)
If already documented in DEFECT_LIBRARY.md: cross-reference DL-ID and resolution date
If not documented: file new DL entry with severity Critical
Remove from HO reporting baseline regardless of resolution
batches.risk: MEDIUM — certified items with structural defects. Archive is safe default.

phases.description: Items where the labeled cognitive level is 2+ tiers above the true level. These are definition-to-term matching, single-concept classification, or deterministic rule application items labeled as Evaluate or Analyze. Highest-leverage correction — 56 items account for ~19% of HO overstatement.

phases.description: Items where the labeled cognitive level is exactly 1 tier above the true level. Content is well-written — labels only.

batches.action: Apply semantic review results for AF-1 ceiling items.

reclassification.pattern: Stem embeds textbook definition in business scenario without explicit 'what term is this' language. Candidate must recognize the concept being defined.
reclassification.true_level: Understand (concept recognition in scenario) or Apply (if scenario requires mapping to specific standard)

batches.methodology: LLM-based topic classification or human semantic review. Read stem, identify if the question asks 'what is being described' vs. 'analyze this situation.'

batches.label: Phase B Semantic Review — Borderline Items
batches.action: Apply semantic review results for borderline items.

sub_categories.category: Borderline AF-2 (multi-step calculation as part of analysis)
sub_categories.methodology: Human spot-check. Distinguish 'calculate X' as the only task (Apply) from 'calculate X, then determine which vendor to choose based on X' (Analyze).

sub_categories.category: Borderline AF-3 (ASC reference is contextual, not deterministic)
sub_categories.methodology: Human spot-check. Distinguish 'apply ASC 450' (Apply) from 'ASC 450 and 275 give different guidance depending on facts — which is more appropriate here?' (Analyze).
Human spot-check. Items where discarding the distractors itself requires analytical reasoning across multiple standards.
